problem_statement:
Improve inline directives for templater context
### Search before asking

- [X] I searched the [issues](https://github.com/sqlfluff/sqlfluff/issues) and found no similar issues.


### Description

I cannot alter jinja context in inline fashion.

Good:

```
[sqlfluff:templater:jinja:context]
my_inline_dict={"k1": "v1", "k2": "v2"}
```

SQL:
```sql
{% for k in my_inline_dict %}
SELECT {{ k }};
{% endfor %}
```

sqlfluff render:
```sql
SELECT k1;

SELECT k2;
```

Bad:
```sql
-- sqlfluff:templater:jinja:context:my_inline_dict:{"k1": "v1", "k2": "v2"}
{% for k in my_inline_dict %}
SELECT {{ k }};
{% endfor %}
```

### Use case

I want to have "local" jinja context in my sql to:
- improve readability
- avoid always-growing and self-conflicting context in .sqlfluff file
